posts.title: Why Did Disney Cancel Wonder Man Season 2?
posts.description: Disney renewed Wonder Man for a second season, then cancelled it only four months later despite strong reviews and an Emmy nomination for Yahya Abdul-Mateen II. The decision raises serious questions about Marvel’s strategy, audience trust and Disney’s increasingly visible pattern of abandoning Black-led television programmes.
